a: Times and locations can change because of weather or resort scheduling. Items marked with a red star are still being confirmed.
We update this page as soon as we know, and post same-day changes in the WhatsApp group.
The à la carte restaurants (Wok Wok, Verdello, Brgrs.Ph and Space Walker) open at 5:30 PM and need a reservation, made on the resort app. The daily booking window is 9 AM – 3 PM.
The Explorer's Table buffet (6 – 10 PM) needs no reservation.
On Saturday, December 19, no reservations are needed.

questions.q: Where can I eat during the day?
a: - Breakfast buffet: Explorer's Table, 7 – 11 AM
- Sweetery: Gourmet Village, 7 AM – 11 PM
- Aqua Bites: Aqua Nick, 10 AM – 5 PM
- Fresco: behind Building 2, 11 AM – 5 PM
- Nick Bistro: in front of Building 1 on the beach, 12:30 – 3 PM
- Lunch buffet: Explorer's Table, 12:30 – 3 PM
- Room service: 24 hours

questions.q: Are there dairy-free or gluten-free treats?
a: The popcorn cart is dairy-free and gluten-free. Sweetery has sorbet as a dairy-free, gluten-free option.

questions.q: When are the pools and towel bar open?
a: Pools are open until 7 PM. The towel bar is staffed 8 AM – 5 PM; towels are still available after that, but no staff will be there.

questions.q: When can I use the golf carts?
a: Golf carts run from 8 AM.
Every building except Building 1.

questions.q: Where can I play table tennis?
a: There are two open table tennis stations every day between Buildings 8 and 9, and one next to the Show Lounge.

questions.q: Is there a kids' club or babysitting?
a: The kids' club at Nickelodeon Place is for ages 4 and up, for activities rather than babysitting.
There's no babysitting area, but in-room babysitting can be requested for a fee.
- Cotton candy at Sweetery: $7
- Cars in Kids' Corner: $7 for 5 minutes
- Personal Sliming, It's Pizza Time, the Character Breakfast and the Ninja Turtle Power Dinner: reservation and payment required
- Spa treatments

questions.q: How do I book Personal Sliming or other paid Nickelodeon activities?
a: Email jesantos@nick-resorts.com with the subject "Husna Guest". The Email to book link on each activity fills this in for you.
Book online at https://husnabrx.com/excursions/ or visit the BRX table in the lobby. Husna-exclusive excursions:
- Catamaran + Cenote Experience: Sun, Dec 20 and Tue, Dec 22 at 7:45 AM
- Dolphin Encounter, Swim Adventure & Royal Swim: Sun, Dec 20 at 1:30 PM
- Eco Park: Mon, Dec 21 at 8:40 AM and 12:40 PM
- Golf with Brother Asif: Mon, Dec 21 at 11:50 AM
- Beach Horse Excursion with Sr. Sadaf: Mon, Dec 21 at 4 PM

questions.q: How do I book the spa?
a: Spa reservations are required. Booking details were sent by email.
Some spa times are reserved for women only, men only (male therapist available) or mother & daughter. Check each day's itinerary.

questions.q: Who can help with non-inclusive bookings and special requests?
a: The Gazebo concierge, in front of each building, 8 AM – 5 PM.
